steps.title: Set up plate layout
steps.instruction: Arrange up to four custom tube racks and a 96‑well deepwell plate; the first sample will be placed in well A11 and subsequent samples will be filled by moving across the row.

steps.title: Transfer sample to plate
steps.instruction: For each sample, pick up a fresh tip, aspirate the chosen volume (25 µL or 50 µL) from the tube rack, and dispense it into the current well of the deepwell plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 25 µL or 50 µL from the tube rack
Dispense into the well (starting at A11)

steps.title: Repeat for all samples
steps.instruction: Continue the transfer process, moving to the next well in the same row after each dispense, until the specified number of samples has been transferred.
